about: A one-off probe of level 3's files on base 44 (release 0.26): reads of names that try to leave the pack's folder, writes from 256 KiB to 2.125 MiB read back, names with slashes, a list. One test a frame, once; results in user/pf/save-sonde/results.log and on the log. It changes no place of the firmware and needs the base. Not for the listing.
name: save-sonde
